sloka: तस्य तत् वचनम् श्रुत्वा विश्वामित्रस्य धीमतः ।हृष्ट रोमा महातेजाः शताअनन्दो महातपाः ॥१-५१-१॥
transliteration: tasya tat vacanam śrutvā viśvāmitrasya dhīmataḥ ।hṛṣṭa romā mahātejāḥ śatāanando mahātapāḥ ॥1-51-1॥

translations.english: Satananda the eldest son of Gautama, a great sage who looked brilliant with the power of austerities was thrilled to hear the words of Viswamitra the intellectual and experienced great astonishment on beholding Rama.
translations.hindi: गौतम ऋषि के शाप से नपुंसकत्व को प्राप्त हुए एवं उदास मन इन्द्र, अग्नि आदि देवताओं, सिद्धां, गन्धर्वो और चारणो से बोले
